name: openrouter
description: The whole of OpenRouter behind one mod: 400+ models from 100+ providers, searchable by price, context, modality and capability; chat and completion with full provider routing (order, only, ignore, sort, fallbacks, quantization, data-collection policy); per-provider endpoint pricing, uptime and throughput; real spend per generation; key and credit state; and provisioning-key management. Twelve MCP tools serve the same code the REST API and the browser console do, so an agent, a shell and a human never see different answers. BYOK throughout — every call spends the caller's own OpenRouter credits.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

endpoints.chat: POST /chat {model|models, messages|prompt, system, temperature, max_tokens, tools, response_format, reasoning, provider, transforms, stream}
endpoints.generation: GET /generation?id=gen-… — native token counts and what it really cost
endpoints.key: GET /key — key label, usage, limit, rate limit + credit balance
endpoints.state: GET /state — which keys this request resolved to, and the spend guard
endpoints.raw: POST /raw {path, method, body, params} — any OpenRouter route

byok.rule: every call spends the caller's own OpenRouter credits — this module holds no house key

env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: inference key, checked before the keystore
env.OPENROUTER_SPEND_USD: spend guard: an estimated chat above this needs confirm=true (default 0.50)
env.OPENROUTER_CACHE_TTL: seconds the model catalog is cached (default 600)
